ops.title: Reduce long-running lane session and tooling CPU/RAM overhead
ops.description: Owner: root tooling campaign. Next after the active GitHub quota repair is installed and verified. First executable step: profile a representative naturally active and idle long-running lane, inspect its actual Claude launch settings, plugins/MCP servers/hooks and helper processes, and identify role-specific components that can be removed or started only when needed. Preserve user-facing behavior and all existing sessions; ship durable lane defaults and verify newly launched lanes without synthetic load.

ops.text: Record per-lane natural CPU/RAM and helper-process baseline, with concrete attribution to Claude configuration and tooling.
Implement minimal role-specific session/tooling configuration that removes unused costs and preserves necessary capabilities; regression checks pass.
Merge, release and install the changes locally; verify naturally launched lanes use the new configuration and measure their resource cost.
